decisions.question: What mechanism delivers the workspace.toml config-editing skill into rank-1 single-repo workspaces, covering both new and already-adopted repos?
decisions.chosen: Extend the embedded-plugin auto-install gate to rank-1

decisions.question: What should the skill's content be sourced from so its schema/edit guidance doesn't drift the way DESIGN-workspace-config.md did?
decisions.chosen: Live-source-grounded content, with a narrow guide carve-out for vault

decisions.question: Should niwa init --bootstrap's scaffold template change to seed the chosen mechanism for brand-new adopters?
decisions.chosen: No scaffold-template change; wire configurePluginAutoInstall into defaultRunBootstrap (internal/cli/init.go)
